brca_population.decided: by the user on 2026-10-09, before any outcome analysis

panels.source: Step 1 A4: ordered gene axis read from each head's stored predictions; identical across E, P, T within each cancer (results/tcga_final/audit/A4_panels.csv)

TCGA-BRCA.head: IDC
TCGA-BRCA.excluded_why: Step 1 A7: ePathST-E head collapsed, test PCC 0.011; rebuilt for E, P and T from results/tcga_final/predictions_rebuilt/TCGA-BRCA/

tcga_ensemble.averaging: un-standardised per fold (z * (sigma + eps) + mu), then arithmetic mean over the kept folds
tcga_ensemble.note: seed 1 is not used for any TCGA ensemble; the seed-1 H-Optimus-0 collapse at ccRCC fold 4 (A7) therefore does not affect these predictions (see DEVIATIONS.md)

collapse_rule: fold model collapsed if validation PCC (mean over genes) < 0.05 OR median per-gene prediction SD across validation spots < 0.01 x target SD; excluded from the TCGA ensemble for every system sharing that fold head

aggregation.primary: mean over all retained spots, un-standardized scale

screen.fdr: BH per system over 150 gene-cancer pairs

survival.test: Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t, df=24, two-sided

families: see Testing hierarchy section of FINAL_GUIDE.md
spatial_features: none: no tumour-stroma contrast in this round
prior_looks: none computed before commit; only feasibility counts (patients, events, missing covariates). Searched srihith/final_experiments, results/ and the 2026-10-09 logs: no RNA-screen, correlation or survival outputs exist from the earlier plan run
